description: Utility functions for typeahead.js, including environment detection, string manipulation, type checks, array/object operations, and function throttling/debouncing.

methods.name: isMsie
methods.description: Detects if the browser is Internet Explorer or Trident-based.

methods.name: isBlankString
methods.description: Checks if a string is null, undefined, or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: escapeRegExChars
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if an object is a string.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if an object is a number.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if an object is an array (uses jQuery).

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Checks if an object is a function (uses jQuery).

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if an object is a plain object (uses jQuery).

methods.name: isUndefined
methods.description: Checks if an object is undefined.

methods.name: isElement
methods.description: Checks if an object is a DOM element.

methods.name: isJQuery
methods.description: Checks if an object is a jQuery object.

methods.name: toStr
methods.description: Converts a value to string, returns empty string if undefined or null.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a function to a context (uses jQuery.proxy).

methods.name: each
methods.description: Iterates over a collection, calling a callback with value and index.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a collection to a new array (uses jQuery).

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a collection (uses jQuery).

methods.name: every
methods.description: Checks if all elements pass a test.

methods.name: some
methods.description: Checks if any element passes a test.

methods.name: mixin
methods.description: Extends an object with properties from another object (uses jQuery.extend).

methods.name: identity
methods.description: Returns the input value.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Deep clones an object (uses jQuery.extend).

methods.name: getIdGenerator
methods.description: Returns a function that generates unique IDs.

methods.name: templatify
methods.description: Converts an object to a template function or string.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers execution of a function asynchronously.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Returns a debounced version of a function.

methods.name: throttle
methods.description: Returns a throttled version of a function.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Converts a value to a string.

methods.name: guid
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random GUID.

methods.name: noop
methods.description: Empty function.
